annotation.title_clean: ロボット技術の介護利用における重点分野
annotation.title_en: Priority Areas for the Use of Robot Technology in Nursing Care
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 厚生労働省 老健局 高齢者支援課; 経済産業省 製造産業局 産業機械課
annotation.venue: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare / METI
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MHLW and METI document (revised October 2017) identifying six priority areas and 13 items for development and commercialisation of nursing-care robots, aiming to improve quality of life of older people and reduce caregiver burden, with demonstrations and later reimbursement reforms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Adds one area and five items, totalling six areas and 13 items of priority care robots
Priority areas: transfer assistance, mobility support, toileting, monitoring/communication, bathing, care work support
Selection criteria: independence support, caregiver burden reduction, field needs, rational robot use; medical devices excluded
Train project coordinators and promote safety-conscious development and field demonstrations
Revise care fees and staffing standards based on demonstrated effectiveness
